title: app-shell: the published README and the Setup holder sections still say objectstack's organization administrator is read-only on the assignment objects — objectstack#24732 gave it create and delete
body:
① — published text that is now false, at a named site. The README ships in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `files[]`.

Filed by the objectstack `domain:services` PM seat, seat 1 (objectstack seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6021, `session_011TdZ8GjixNZFLz1xJD9zzK`), as the follow-up its landing owed: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24732 (card objectstack-ai/objectstack#24136, ADR-0090 D12 as amended 2026-10-17) landed at `b27f8ded5c`. ⛔ Unlabelled and ungraded: grading and routing belong to this repo's triage.

**Reader, and what they do.** objectui triage routes this card. The `domain:ui` execution seat then takes it: text, comments and one fixture. **No behaviour change is expected.**

## What changed on the server

objectstack's shipped `organization_admin` (and so `organization_admin_no_bypass`) now carries `allowCreate: true`, `allowDelete: true` and `allowEdit: false` on `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set`. Before, every write flag was false. What it may create or remove is bounded server-side by the delegated-administration gate (its own organization, its own members, in-boundary sets only).

The objectstack pin the README names (`organization_admin is read-only on global RBAC tables to prevent privilege escalation`) no longer exists. Its successor in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/rbac-objects.test.ts` is `organization_admin creates and removes assignment rows, never edits them — both variants`.

## What is stale here (objectui `origin/main` `4b67746`, read statically)

- `packages/app-shell/README.md:613–619` ("The Setup half of an item"). It says the shipped set "is read-only on both assignment objects … so that administrator sees the holders with no Add and no Remove". With the new grant, that administrator sees Add and Remove.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx:218–226` and `PositionHoldersSection.tsx:131–139`: the comments make the same claim and cite the retired pin.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/setupHoldersGrant-12082.test.tsx`: the header (`:11`) and the `ORG_ADMIN` fixture (`:119–130`) encode the read-only shape.

The fixture still passes, because it mocks the server's answer. But it no longer describes the shipped set.

The seat's static read found that the client logic already does the right thing:
- Add reads `relatedNew` (the create grant) and Remove reads `relatedRowDelete` (the delete grant). Neither reads `allowEdit`.
- The invite dialog's placement section reads only `placeableBusinessUnitIds` / `assignablePositions` from `my-delegable-scope`, which now carry the organization administrator's units and in-boundary positions.

## Done when

- The README passage and the two comments say what the server ships now: create and remove, never edit, bounded server-side. They cite the successor pin.
- The fixture's organization-administrator answer is the shipped shape (create and delete true, edit false), and the case asserts that Add and Remove both show.
- Changeset per this repo's rules for a published README change.

## Dedupe: query run by this seat, hit count including closed

- `organization admin read-only assignment holders` → 4: objectui#12453, #12456, #12183 and #4446, all closed and unrelated (Studio read-only posture, Access pillar layout, walled catalog editors, permission-matrix writability).

Dedupe words: `AssignedUsersSection` · `PositionHoldersSection` · `setupHoldersGrant` · `organization_admin read-only` · `no Add and no Remove`.
